description-zh: URL 编码/解码字符串，并将字典构建为查询串
description-en: URL-encode/decode string and build query string from dict
code:
from urllib.parse import quote, unquote, urlencode

def url_tools(s: str, params: dict):
    enc = quote(s, safe='')
    dec = unquote(enc)
    query = urlencode(params, doseq=True)
    return enc, dec, query
